register: adversarial conversational / elliptical; single-clause; intent unambiguous
policy: Parser-blind holdout generated after the epoch-016 freeze without access to parser outputs, repairs, or failure traces. Any core/prompt/repair/scorer/connector change invalidates this holdout (see freezes/epoch-016.json). Golds compile under FROZEN IR spec v2.1 (algebra/ir-spec.md); no new ops, fields, or vocab; no unsupported annotation layers, no spatial mean over Series, no multi-output asks, no all-pairs distance, no inexpressible algebra, no unstated transfer methods.

conventions.gold_shape: op skeleton with REGION nodes excluded (both SELECT.region resolvers and ESTIMATE targets).
conventions.source_gap: literal unsupported entity/source or non-curated region: gold leaf is BOUND (no hole), empty SELECT is a data gap, expect=data_request with must_hole=false.
conventions.deictic_hole: hole placed only in a genuinely unresolved role (entity/place/proxy); time is never a hole; expect=data_request with must_hole=true.
conventions.orientation: COMPARE difference/ratio operands written in question order; time change is later-minus-earlier, place-vs-place keeps first-named=left (v2.1).
